items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: We had Bud Scott, Papa Mutt, Eddie Garland, myself, Ory, and I think we had Fred Washington for a while.

ctx.x: That Taxi Dance Hall, was that on 3rd Street?

Yeah, 3rd, right off of Maine. There was two we worked. We worked one there and one at a fellow by the name of Jack Goldboy. See, he had one. It's called Red Mill. So we worked this Taxi Dance Hall until Ory got lined up pretty good, and that's when we changed the band a little around. Then we had the real band we had. We had Bud Scott, Papa Mutt, Eddie Garland, myself, Ory, and I think we had Fred Washington for a while.
We saw Fred Washington last night.
